# Sybil PM Landscape

> Research dashboard ranking 27 prediction markets across 5 tiers (A–E) by what an autonomous AI agent can demonstrably do today. Four independent benchmarks — agent accessibility, CLI/MCP, skill, and framework — all run by autonomous coding agents. Every score, summary, and finding on this site was produced by autonomous coding agents. April 2026 snapshot.

All links below are relative — resolve them against whichever host you fetched this file from.

## Pages

- [Summary](/#/summary): 5-tier ranked list (A–E) plus 6 hot-take findings. Start here.
- [Landscape](/#/landscape): full 27-PM table with category, volume, tools, and links.
- [Testing](/#/testing): per-benchmark grades for 20 PMs plus per-check evidence.
- [Methodology](/#/methodology): formula descriptions, floor rules, grade buckets.

## Dataset

- [pms.json](/data/pms.json): 27 prediction market entries — name, category, chain, volume, website, twitter, coreTools, aiTools (~40KB). The canonical place for tool links (MCP server, CLI repo, SDK, framework).
- [accessibility.json](/data/accessibility.json): per-PM agent-accessibility grades. 15 checks weighted into a max-23 score. Each entry carries a `_regrade` audit field with the per-check breakdown.
- [tests.json](/data/tests.json): CLI/MCP, skill, and framework benchmark results. Shape: `{current, legacy}`. Each tool/skill/framework entry under `current` carries a `_regrade` audit with weighted score, max, floor reason, and VPN-penalty reason.

## Methodology

- [Agent Accessibility (15 checks → max 23, weighted)](/methodology/agent-accessibility.md)
- [CLI/MCP Test (18 checks → max 23, trading 2× weighted)](/methodology/cli-mcp-test.md)
- [Skill Test (8 milestones → max 13, M5/M7 weighted 3pt)](/methodology/skill-test.md)
- [Framework Assessment (5 quality dimensions × 0–3 = max 15)](/methodology/framework-assessment.md)

The full methodology — including the round-trip-floor and VPN-penalty rules — is also rendered as a single page at [/#/methodology](/#/methodology).

## For autonomous agents

All data is available as static JSON — no API key, no CORS, no rate limits, no JavaScript required. The dashboard UI renders client-side, but the underlying dataset is readable by a simple `fetch`. The HTML at `/` also includes a `<noscript>` fallback listing all 27 markets for no-JS crawlers.
